> A home-based artisan bakery specializing in custom-designed cakes, handcrafted cookies, gift boxes, and baked goods. The business emphasizes handmade quality and creative, personalized designs, giving it a warm, boutique feel with an artisanal touch. Each product appears to be crafted with care and attention to detail, suggesting a brand identity rooted in creativity, craftsmanship, and personal warmth.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About פירורים
A home-based artisan bakery specializing in custom-designed cakes, handcrafted cookies, gift boxes, and baked goods. The business emphasizes handmade quality and creative, personalized designs, giving it a warm, boutique feel with an artisanal touch. Each product appears to be crafted with care and attention to detail, suggesting a brand identity rooted in creativity, craftsmanship, and personal warmth.

## Target Audience
- חובבי עוגות מעוצבות
- רוכשי מארזי מתנה
- חובבי מזון בעבודת יד

## Industry
Home Bakery / Artisan Food
